answer: The delta counter is kept in ledge and crystal publishes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 613 identities would post 1228 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
